rationale: Both candidates miss the three most concrete, reproduced ground-truth bugs (max_num_seqs default divergence causing MingImagePipeline startup failure; model_subdir/tokenizer_subdir precedence loss; omni_kv_config precedence reversal), so recall is low for both. X's ownership-validation finding and parity-test critique are thematically adjacent to GT's ownership/parity concerns but manifest as opposite symptoms (hard-reject vs silent-drop) and different specifics; Y's deploy-engine_extras ownership gap and custom_voice_dir/non-backend-field parity-test gap align more precisely with GT's actual language ("deploy engine_extras are never checked", "only compares hard-coded defaults"). Both are well-evidenced with concrete file:line citations and reproductions, giving comparable precision and actionability; X offers broader coverage (9 findings vs 5) with clear prioritization, but Y's tighter alignment to the ground-truth reviewer's specific concerns gives it a slight recall edge.
